div.ab: XCIII. Gif mon on his mæstene unalyfed swin gemete, genime ðonne VI scll' weorð wed.
XCII[I]. Gif mon on his mæstenne unaliefed swín gemete, genime þonne VI scill. weorð wed.
Si quis obuiet porco sine licentia in pasnagio suo, capiat uadium sex solid. ualens.
{XCII[I]} Gif mon on his mæstenne unaliefed swin gemete, genime þonne VI sciƚƚ weorð wed.
If someone finds swine on his pasture without permission, let him then take a pledge-payment of 6 shillings.
If anyone finds swine intruding in his mast pasture, he may take security to the value of 6 shillings.
Wenn jemand innerhalb seiner Mast Schweine ohne Erlaubniss antrifft, dann nehme er [an ihnen] ein 6 Schill. werthes Pfand.
If someone comes upon pigs within his pannage without permission, then let him take [from them] a pledge worth 6 shillings.
